result.instructions: Tools for Enginemailer, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Look up the subscriber jane@example.com and show her custom fields and lists."; "Add john@example.com to my Newsletter list with the source 'Signup from website'."; "How did my last delivered campaign perform: opens, clicks, bounces?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Enginemailer data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run enginemailer_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run enginemailer_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run enginemailer_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. enginemailer_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: enginemailer_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get subscriber
tools.description: One subscriber by email: id, status and all custom field values. GET /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/getSubscriber.

tools.name: enginemailer_list_subscriber_categories
tools.title: List subscriber categories
tools.description: The subscriber category tree: each category with its subcategories (ids, names). Use the subcategory ids when adding or updating subscribers and when assigning campaign recipients. GET /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/getSubCategory.

include_active_subscriber_count.description: Also return active subscriber counts (only for accounts the vendor has enabled this for).

tools.name: enginemailer_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The subscriber custom field definitions (key, name, type). Use the keys when adding or updating subscribers. GET /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/getCustomField.

tools.name: enginemailer_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: add a subscriber to the account (optionally into subcategories, with custom field values). Only add people who consented to marketing email. Free accounts may insert 50 subscribers a day, paid accounts 10,000. POST /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/insertSubscriber.

value.description: The value. Dates 'dd MMM yyyy', phones '+<country><number>', checkbox values separated by '|'.

source_type.description: Where the subscriber came from, e.g. 'Signup from website' (max 256).

tools.name: enginemailer_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing subscriber's subcategories and/or custom fields. subcategories_mode: append (default), remove (drop the given subcategories) or replace (the given list becomes the full list). custom_fields_mode: update_given (change only the given fields) or replace_all (default; fields not given are cleared). POST /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/updateSubscriber.

value.description: The value. Dates 'dd MMM yyyy', phones '+<country><number>', checkbox values separated by '|'.

custom_fields_mode.description: update_given changes only the listed fields; replace_all (the vendor default) clears the others.

tools.name: enginemailer_unsubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Unsubscribe subscriber
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe a subscriber so they no longer receive campaigns. Reversing it needs the subscriber to opt in again in Enginemailer. GET /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/unSubSubscriber.

tools.name: enginemailer_save_subscriber_category
tools.title: Create or update subscriber category
tools.description: WRITE: create a subscriber category (category_id 0) or update one (its id), with subcategories (subcategory_id 0 creates one). Names and descriptions max 128 characters. POST /restapi/subscriber/emsubscriber/updateCategory.

category_id.description: 0 to create a new category, else the existing category id.

subcategory_id.description: 0 to create, else the existing subcategory id.

tools.name: enginemailer_list_campaigns
tools.title: List undelivered campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns that have NOT been delivered yet (drafts and scheduled ones): id, name, subject, sender and schedule. Delivered campaigns are not listed by the API; use enginemailer_get_campaign_stats with a known id. Needs a paid account. GET /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/ListCampaign.

tools.name: enginemailer_get_campaign_stats
tools.title: Get campaign delivery stats
tools.description: Delivery results of a DELIVERED campaign: emails sent, delivered, bounces, opens, unique opens, clicks, unique clicks, unsubscribes, spam complaints. Needs a paid account. GET /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/getcampaigndeliverystatus.

tools.name: enginemailer_list_campaign_categories
tools.title: List campaign categories
tools.description: The categories that campaign recipients can be filtered by (id, name, description). Needs a paid account. GET /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/GetCategoryList.

tools.name: enginemailer_list_campaign_subcategories
tools.title: List campaign subcategories
tools.description: The subcategories of one campaign category (id, name, description); use these ids in enginemailer_assign_campaign_recipients. Needs a paid account. GET /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/GetSubCategoryList.

tools.name: enginemailer_create_campaign
tools.title: Create campaign (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: create a campaign DRAFT. Nothing is sent: assign recipients with enginemailer_assign_campaign_recipients, then send with enginemailer_send_campaign. The sender domain must be verified in Enginemailer; max 200 campaigns per account. Needs a paid account. POST /restapi/Campaign/EMCampaign/CreateCampaign.

sender_email.description: Sender address on a verified domain.

tools.name: enginemailer_assign_campaign_recipients
tools.title: Assign campaign recipients
tools.description: WRITE: set who a campaign will go to: all subscribers, or the subscribers in the given subcategory ids (match_type any = OR, all = AND). Does not send anything. Needs a paid account. POST /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/AssignRecipientList.

match_type.description: any = subscribers in at least one subcategory (OR, default); all = in every one (AND).

tools.name: enginemailer_send_campaign
tools.title: Send campaign NOW
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS NOW and cannot be undone: delivers the campaign to its assigned recipients immediately. The campaign needs at least one recipient and must not be scheduled or already delivered. Show the user the campaign and its audience and get their go-ahead first; set confirm to true only then. Needs a paid account. GET /restapi/campaign/emcampaign/SendCampaign.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved sending this campaign to its recipients now.

tools.name: enginemailer_send_transactional_email
tools.title: Send transactional email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS ONE EMAIL NOW and cannot be undone: submits a transactional email to one recipient (plus optional CC/BCC). Needs a sender address on a verified domain; give either subject + content_html, or a template_id from the Enginemailer portal (the template supplies subject and sender name). Total message incl. attachments max 5 MB. Confirm the recipient and text with the user first; set confirm to true only then. POST /RESTAPI/V2/Submission/SendEmail.

sender_email.description: Sender address on a verified domain (must match the template's sender when template_id is used).

content_html.description: Email body (HTML). Not needed with template_id.

template_id.description: Stored template id from the Enginemailer portal.

substitution_tags.description: Merge tags. Values must not contain { } [ ].

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has approved sending this email now.

tools.name: enginemailer_start_transactional_report_export
tools.title: Start transactional report export
tools.description: Start a CSV export of the transactional email delivery report for a period (start date at most 60 days back). Returns an export id; poll it with enginemailer_check_transactional_report_export. Creates a report file only; nothing is sent. POST /RESTAPI/V2/Submission/Report/Export.

period.description: Date range exactly like '1 Sep 2026 - 16 Sep 2026'.

email_to_filter.description: Only emails sent to this recipient.

domain_filter.description: Domain filter, sent as the vendor's DomainFilter (the sender domain in the vendor's report), e.g. example.com.

tools.name: enginemailer_check_transactional_report_export
tools.title: Check transactional report export
tools.description: Status of a report export (Processing or Complete); when complete it includes the CSV download URL. POST /RESTAPI/V2/Submission/Report/CheckExport (read-only).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Enginemailer
prompts.description: What you can do with Enginemailer here, with example requests to try.
